summary: Neo and Agent Smith engage in a high-speed gunfight, utilizing bullet-time effects to illustrate their impossible speed. They close the distance until they are nearly touching, jamming their guns against each other's heads in a mirrored stance. Both pull their triggers simultaneously, resulting in an empty click for each. Agent Smith reacts with rage, transitioning into a brutal hand-to-hand combat sequence where he punches Neo against a steel column, shattering it, and delivers a reverse round-house that knocks Neo's glasses off. Smith declares he will enjoy watching Neo die before continuing to pound him with fists.

what_changes.before: Armed and moving at impossible speed
what_changes.after: Injured (forearm opened, glasses lost) and being physically overwhelmed
what_changes.evidence: A knife-hand opens his forearm, and a kick sends him slamming back against a steel column.

what_changes.after: Warped with rage, attacking with unrelenting fury
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith's face warps with rage and he attacks, fists flying at furious speed

event_hint.one_line: Neo and Agent Smith fight in a subway station, transitioning from gunplay to hand-to-hand combat.
